expressions.title: The Port Hajj Committees Act (Repeal) Ordinance, 1961
expressions.title_basis: p1 (Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Karachi, September 29, 1961, p.1495) prints the Ministry of Railways and Communications notification, 'ORDINANCE No. XXXVIII OF 1961 AN ORDINANCE to repeal the Port Hajj Committee Act, 1932', ss.1-2; p2 (p.1496) s.3 and the signatures ending 'H. S. M. ISHAQUE, Secretary' (block 2345303). Ordinance No. XXXIX of 1961 (the Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961) follows and is held released as document 2766: set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split').
